artworks.title: Ginger Cat in the Meadow
artworks.description: A ginger cat sitting among yellow wildflowers, looking at the hills under a soft pink evening sky.

artworks.title: Lady with the Lace Umbrella
artworks.description: A lady in a dark gown with a lace umbrella, butterflies around her and a little black cat at her feet, among bare trees and mist.

artworks.title: Cottage with Wildflowers
artworks.description: An old village house with a red roof, almost hidden by a garden full of wildflowers. Born to live in a cozy cottage with flowers everywhere…

artworks.title: Pegasus
artworks.description: A white winged horse leaping through pink and blue clouds above a field of flowers.

artworks.title: Venice in the Rain
artworks.description: Piazza San Marco on a rainy evening: warm lights reflected on the wet stones and little red umbrellas.

artworks.title: Herbarium
artworks.description: Delicate botanical study of mint, thyme and wild herbs in a gold frame.

artworks.title: White Goose
artworks.description: A proud white goose in front of an old farmhouse, painted in warm, golden summer light.

artworks.title: Cabin in the Misty Forest
artworks.description: A little red-roofed cabin at the edge of a pine forest, with the morning mist still hanging between the trees.

artworks.title: Still Life with Jug and Apples
artworks.description: A copper jug, an old bottle and a glass carafe with two apples, in front of bright rainbow drapery.

artworks.title: Black Swans
artworks.description: Three black swans gliding over a misty lilac lake.

artworks.title: Old Town House
artworks.description: A traditional Bulgarian house with white walls, wooden bay windows and a stone-paved street, with grapevines over the gate.

artworks.title: Peonies
artworks.description: Big, blooming peonies in cream, pink and coral, painted with loose and expressive strokes.

artworks.title: Unicorn in the Misty Valley
artworks.description: A white unicorn running through a green valley where the fog is rising from the hills.

artworks.title: Old House in Autumn
artworks.description: A yellow village house with blue shutters, surrounded by autumn trees.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.description: A dreamy portrait of a girl with long golden hair, on a deep blue background.

artworks.title: Autumn by the Rocks
artworks.description: Orange, red and golden trees in front of a huge white rock with a cave.

artworks.title: Rose and Butterfly
artworks.description: A single red rose and a pink butterfly on an aged, golden background in an ornate frame.

artworks.title: Rainy Day in the City
artworks.description: A vintage street scene: people in long coats, a little girl in red, an old car and wet pavements.

artworks.title: The Yellow Palace
artworks.description: A sunny yellow palace with white columns and red roofs on a bright summer day.

artworks.title: Still Life with Pomegranate
artworks.description: A wicker bottle, a glass jar with rosehip branches, a pomegranate and a lemon on deep blue drapery.
